title: A closed case reopens through the explicit reopen branch
risk: A dissatisfied customer cannot reopen a closed case, so the complaint is lost and the reopen KPI is wrong. The blueprint names a REOPENED branch while the SRS lists only the seven minimum states, so the transition here is proposed configuration.
preconditions: A CLOSED case CASE-T1-0008 for cust-a in namespace cd-reopen-*
Tenant policy publish_case_reopen enabled with a 30 day reopen window

steps.action: Apply the explicit reopen event inside the policy window
steps.expected: the case enters REOPENED with the previous resolution retained and a reopen timestamp recorded

steps.action: Apply an identical reopen event again
steps.expected: no second reopen entry is produced and the case stays REOPENED

steps.action: Attempt a reopen 45 days after closure
steps.expected: the reopen is refused by the window policy and the case stays CLOSED

steps.action: Read the reopen KPI input for the tenant
steps.expected: the reopened case is counted exactly once in the Reopen Rate numerator for the period

assertions: The in-window reopen produces state REOPENED with one reopen audit entry and the original resolution preserved
The out-of-window reopen is refused and the case stays CLOSED
The Reopen Rate input counts the case exactly once
forbidden: Reopen a closed case while discarding the previous resolution or its evidence
Count the same reopen twice in the KPI input
evidence: Case projection after each reopen attempt with the retained resolution reference
Reopen Rate input rows for the tenant period
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped reopen rows for cd-reopen-*; restore the policy flag to its fixture value
automation: Run the real state machine with the reopen branch enabled by tenant policy; because the SRS fixes only the minimum states, this case is labelled a proposed configuration and must not be reported as SRS-mandated.
